_comment: Avatar tuning configuration. Controls anatomy, mesh processing, eye/head behaviour, and viseme strength. Changes take effect after a page reload.

headDynamics._comment: Controls head pitch/yaw range and inertia during speech and idle.

anatomicalPostProcessing._comment: Separates face into anatomical zones and applies independent strength multipliers.

meshPostProcessing._comment: Controls temporal smoothing and mesh-level corrections per face zone.

visemeOverrides._comment: Per-phoneme-group strength scaling (100 = no change, 150 = 50% amplified).

emotionControl._comment: Baseline emotion state applied to the avatar when no session override is active.
